lines.description: Order lines in the order they appear in the message. At most 100.

rawText.description: The exact span of the message this line was read from, copied verbatim (at most 500 characters).

productCode.description: A product code, SKU or barcode only if it is literally written in the message; otherwise null. Never invent or complete a code.

productText.description: The product as described in the message (name, specification, model), without the quantity and unit. 1-200 characters.

quantity.description: Positive quantity as written (number words like 'iki' become 2). Null when the message gives no quantity for this line.

unit.description: Unit written for the quantity, normalised (tane/ad -> adet, takım/tk -> takim, mt/m -> metre, çift -> cift, lt -> litre). Null when no unit is written.

brandModel.description: Brand, vehicle model or series mentioned for this product (for example 'CG 125'), else null.

confidence.description: Your certainty from 0 to 1 that this is an order line and was read correctly.

notes.description: Short remark for the human reviewer (for example a price expression or 'as last time'), else null. At most 300 characters.

unparsedFragments.description: Parts of the message that may matter but are not order lines (questions, instructions, unclear text). Greetings can be left out. At most 50.

warnings.description: Codes describing notable content of the message.
